records.jp: ん？　なーに話してんの？
ああ、星崎さん
いろいろ、大変なこともありますけど……<CR>このあたりで一度、気分転換でもしたいなと話していて
records.en_original: We were just saying that we could use a change of pace after everything that's happened.
records.en: We were just saying that we could use a change of pace after everything that's happened.

records.jp: せっかくならみんなともっと仲良くなりたいし、<CR>親睦を深める機会があったらいいなって
records.en_original: It would be nice to have some time to get to know each other better now that we're all here.
records.en: It would be nice to have some time to get to know each other better now that we're all here.

records.jp: おお！　いいね！！
何する予定なの？
何班かに分かれてお弁当を作って、<CR>みんなで持ち寄って屋上で食べるとか、どう？
records.en_original: What about splitting up into groups and having a potluck on the roof?
records.en: What about splitting up into groups and having a potluck on the roof?

records.jp: せっかくなら屋上にいろいろ飾りつけしたり……
records.en_original: We could decorate the roof for the occasion!
records.en: We could decorate the roof for the occasion!

records.jp: うんうん……あ、そうだ
夏だし、ここから一番下まで届く<CR>超巨大流しそうめん装置を作ろうよ！
records.en_original: Since it's summer, why don't we make a giant water slide that goes from here all the way down!
records.en: Since it's summer, why don't we make a giant water slide that goes from here all the way down!

records.jp: ここから……
下まで……？
愛央らしいアイデア
でしょ？　ほら、どっかのココロトープに<CR>竹あったでしょ？　あれを並べて――
records.en_original: You mean amazing? I bet we could find materials in the Heartscape and—
records.en: You mean amazing? I bet we could find materials in the Heartscape and—

records.jp: ん？
どうしたの、愛央？
あんなところに島……？<CR>あったっけ……？
records.en_original: An island all the way out there? Has that always been there?
records.en: An island all the way out there? Has that always been there?

records.jp: いや、絶対ない。あったらもっと早く気づくもん。<CR>と、とにかくユズたちを呼ぼう！
records.en_original: No way. We would have noticed sooner if it was. Let's call Yuzu and Lime!
records.en: No way. We would have noticed sooner if it was. Let's call Yuzu and Lime!

records.jp: わー！　ホントに島だ！
records.en_original: Whoa, there really is an island!
records.en: Whoa, there really is an island!

records.jp: 島だね……
あれ、何か分かる……？
records.en_original: Do you know anything about it?
records.en: Do you know anything about it?

records.jp: いや、わっかんない……。<CR>ライム、どう……？
みんなの想いに変化があれば、<CR>それが反映されて世界に異変が起きることもあると思う
records.en_original: A change in everyone's emotions could cause a change like this in the world.
records.en: A change in everyone's emotions could cause a change like this in the world.

records.jp: ま、想定外ではあるけどね……
見に行くか
……まあ、それが一番早いかも
あれがいいものなのか悪いものなのか、<CR>はっきりさせておきたいですね
records.en_original: It would be best to know if it's something we should worry about or not.
records.en: It would be best to know if it's something we should worry about or not.

records.jp: みんなにも声かけてくる！
records.en_original: I'll go let everyone else know!
records.en: I'll go let everyone else know!

records.jp: 私たちで渡る用の船を用意しよう
records.en_original: We'll need a boat that can take us over.
records.en: We'll need a boat that can take us over.

records.jp: うん
じゃ改めて、桟橋集合で！
records.en_original: Let's meet up at the pier!
records.en: Let's meet up at the pier!
